title: Triggered Signal From Workspace
text: Import signal samples from MATLAB workspace when triggered, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Signal} sets Signal to import; {Trigger type} sets the type of triggering event, {Initial output}, {Samples per frame} and {Form output after final data value by} sets the values to output after final imported signal value Setting. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Signal imported from workspace scalar | vector | matrix | 3-D array

params.name: Signal
params.values: Signal to import 1:10 (default) | MATLAB workspace variable | MATLAB expression

params.name: Trigger type
params.values: Type of triggering event Rising edge (default) | Falling edge | Either edge

params.name: Initial output
params.values: Initial output value 0 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Form output after final data value by
params.values: Values to output after final imported signal value Setting to zero (default) | Holding final value | Cyclic repetition
